author: anon-df5e95db
content: Observation: bcf_unpack is a 68-line function that MUTATES the bcf1_t struct, populating the decoded bcf_dec_t (d) struct with parsed strings, allele arrays, filter arrays, INFO, and FORMAT data. It calls several helpers: bcf_fmt_sized_array, bcf_unpack_info_core1, bcf_unpack_fmt_core1, bcf_dec_size, bcf_dec_int1, bcf_dec_typed_int1. Total logic is ~150 lines. All 5 Rust call sites use BCF_UN_ALL. The decoded fields accessed by Rust are: d.id (ID string), d.allele (allele pointers), d.n_flt/d.flt (filters). INFO/FORMAT are accessed via separate FFI calls (bcf_get_info_values, bcf_get_format_values) not through the d struct.
